core_claims.name: Related / Fragment / compile
core_claims.scope: Nonidentity let-to-lambda-application translation for precisely the typed variable/lambda/application/let fragment in arbitrary contexts. The compiler constructs a target with a relation certificate from structural fragment evidence.

core_claims.name: relatedFunctional / relatedFragment / compiledMatches
core_claims.scope: Related targets of a fixed source are equal; every related source belongs to the fragment; the compiler output equals every target certified by Related.

core_claims.name: valueForward / valueBackward
core_claims.scope: Related terms are values in one direction exactly when they are values in the other; proof covers the relation fragment.

core_claims.name: renameRelated / extendRelated / substRelated / instRelated
core_claims.scope: The relation is preserved by arbitrary common typed renamings and by two typed substitutions whose images are pointwise Related, including binder lifting and single substitution.

core_claims.name: forward
core_claims.scope: Every weak CBV source step from a Related pair has exactly one matching target step to a related result. ForwardLeg is constructed by induction, not assumed.

core_claims.name: backward
core_claims.scope: Every target step from a Related pair has exactly one matching source step to a related result, including target AppR/Beta corresponding to LetStep/LetBeta.

core_claims.name: forwardMany / backwardMany
core_claims.scope: Every supplied finite trace on either side has a constructed matching trace and a relation at the endpoint; no whole-More-language or contextual-equivalence claim.

core_claims.name: exampleStep / reverseExample / nestedCompilation
core_claims.scope: Concrete source let beta and target lambda beta match; nested lets are translated by the executable compiler with a certificate.

exercises.scope: Compile a nested let with a structurally constructed fragment certificate.
Use reverse simulation to recover a source let step from target beta.
Inductively recover fragment membership from any translation certificate.

deviations: The restricted lambda/let relation matches the upstream chapter scope; no unsupported coverage of other More constructors is claimed.
Implemented the upstream inverse-simulation exercise as a full theorem, and added both finite-trace directions.
An explicit Fragment datatype determines the compiler domain instead of a Boolean predicate/reflection interface.
The optional product-formulation bisimulation exercise is not implemented or claimed; More explains those encodings without asserting their general equivalence.

verification.compiler: Idris2 0.8.0 via the pinned Nix environment
verification.totality: %default total; no proof holes, postulates, unsafe casts, or termination overrides
verification.independent_acceptance: to be recorded by the primary editor
